content: WebAudio hygiene (MDN AudioContext/Using Web Audio API): reuse ONE AudioContext (creating per restart leaks); AudioBufferSourceNode/OscillatorNode are one-shot - garbage collected after onended only if disconnected from graph; per-shot SFX nodes need disconnect on ended or nodes accumulate; decodeAudioData is async and can race with the first user gesture that triggers playback - preload buffers at boot and no-op until ready.
